statusDetail: Cloudflare security verification prevented the raw-CDP browser from reaching the target site. The atomic report is retained as blocked and is not eligible for scoring.

page.notes: The application could not be inspected. Browser recon rendered a Cloudflare verification interstitial; raw curl separately received origin HTML, but raw HTML was not treated as rendered-page evidence.

artifacts.caption: Live entry navigation after waiting: Cloudflare security-verification interstitial instead of Danbooru.
Rendered DOM/CSS capture of the Cloudflare challenge page.
Recon probe showing title “Just a moment...”, no forms, and only Cloudflare links.
Browser navigation to robots.txt was also replaced by the Cloudflare verification page.
Raw HTTP response headers. curl received the origin homepage, confirming the block is specific to the browser audit session.
Raw HTTP homepage body received by curl. Retained only as blocker context; not used to infer rendered quality passes.
Materialised 58-pair atomic coverage manifest from the pinned catalog.
Per-check evidence plan and blocker record.
Pinned Modern Web Guidance catalog consulted before judgement.
Atomic coverage validator output: all 58 rows recorded, all 58 blocked, publication gate failed as required.
